issues.on_page: Capital outlay 47,326 = General 33,242 (Recreation 20,631 + Administrative 12,611, p20/p19) + Street 14,084
issues.issue: Recreation is the largest single function, but it is only 44% of the line. Streets plus general government make up the other 56%. The function is a judgment call; the line has a review note.
The source (state, federal or private) is not stated. The category is defensible but is an assumption (the line has a review note). The same applies to the matching detail lines.

The printed label 'General property tax' is not one of the user's rename rules (the user_rules.py pattern covers Property / Property tax(es) / Real and personal property tax only). The relabel goes beyond the rules; the printed text is kept in printed_label.
